(nya)༄༅/ /sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge'i zla 'od gsar pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dkar mdzes dar bab nam mkha'i ra

tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge'i zla 'od gsar pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dkar mdzes dar bab nam mkha'i rna ba yis// nyi bu'i dpung las rnam rgyal go 'phang nyid// sbyin pa'i mthu chen thob na gang sku yi// mtshungs dper bsngags so yid bzhin 'khor lo ma// gang gi sgrub thabs ngag dbang grags pa yis// 'chi bdag bslu ba'i rtog pa las byung ba'i// gzhung don ji bzhin mkhas pa'i zhal lung brten// tshe sbyin sgrol ma'i bsnyen pa bya tshul 'dri// de'ang 'dir sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs kyi khyad chos mi 'dra ba mang du mchis pa las/ 'dir ngor chen rdo rje 'chang nas brgyud pa rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas bsnyen pa byed pa la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni gnas dben par byi dor byas par 'byor na rje btsun ma'i sku rten bris 'bur gang rung bkrams pa'i mdun du/ yi dam sgrol ma la gtor ma cog zlum gcig sgrol ma'i bka' sdod k+ṣe tra pā la dang 'jigs byed chen mo gnyis la 'bul bar spro na/ thun mong du cog zlum gcig bya/ cha gsum gtor ma btang ba grub na'ang de'i gtor ma dang*/ gzhan nyer spyod bsham pa sogs spyi ltar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la gsum ste skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ tshogs bsags pa'o// dang po skyabs 'gro la/ rgyu yul tshul la sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar shes par bya ba las 'dir 'dri mi dgos mod/ de'i nang nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul gsal 'debs pa'i tshul cung zad smos na/ rang nyid gnas pa'i zhing 'di ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i sa gzhi bai ḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin can gyi dbus su rang nyid gnas pa'i mdun gyi bar snang la rin po che'i khri pad+ma zla ba'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gsal 'debs pa'am/

yang na mdun gyi sa gzhi las yar skyes pa'i tshul gyis dpag bsam gyis yal ga lo ma me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rtse mor pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i lte bar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba thams cad kyang sgrol ma dkar mo'i rnam pa can dang*/ mdun gyi 'dab mar sgrol dkar sogs yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ g.yas kyi 'dab mar longs sprul gyis bsdus pa'i sangs rgyas/ rgyab kyi 'dab mar lung rtogs chos kyi ngo bo glegs bam brtsegs pa/ g.yon gyi 'dab mar byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang nyan thos dgra bcom gyi tshogs/ gzhan yang chos srung nor lha rnams kyang mtha' skor dpag bsam shing gi lo 'dab kun du bzhugs par gsal gdab/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis skyabs su 'gro ba dang skyabs yul rang la bstim pa sogs spyi ltar ro// gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ dkyus kyi tshig de nyid ngag tu brjod cing sems can gyi don du rang nyid sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa ni smon pa'i sems dang*/ de'i ched du sgrol ma dkar mo'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug pa sems bskyed pa yin no// gsum pa tshogs bsags pa la gnyis/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs so// dang po ni/ tshogs zhing spyan drang ba de la phyag bya ba dang mchod pa 'bul ba/ de dag gi spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba rnams sgrub thabs dkyus su gsal ba ltar don yid la dran pa'i sgo nas 'don pa rnams yin no// gnyis pa ni/ rang gi phung khams skye mched la sogs pa'i chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gtan la phab nas de'ang nam mkha' la sprin yal ba ltar mi dmigs par bsam pa nyid do// de rnams ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum ste lha bskyed pa/ bzlas pa bya ba/ sbyin bdag gi ched du dmigs bsal bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ sngar gyi stong nyid de'i ngang las rang sems gsal ba'i gdangs 'gags med yi ge paṃ du gyur pa/
de las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma rgyas pa/ lte ba ge sar dang bcas par bsam/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams pa'i steng du rang sems kyi ngo bo tām̐ dkar po/

bod yig dbu can gyi rnam pa la/ ring cha zla tshes thig le nā da dang bcas par bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas nas 'od zer tshur 'dus tām̐ yig la thim zhing*/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i skur gyur pa ni/ zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par gsal btab pa ni/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag gnas gsum du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo 'bru gsum bsgoms pa ni byin gyis brlabs pa nyer sgrub kyi yan lag snying ga'i tām̐ gyi 'od zer gyis rje btsun ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar spyan drangs nas dgug gzhug bcing dang dbyer med du bya ba dang gdan 'bul ba dang bcas pa ni sgrub pa'i yan lag dbang lha rigs lnga 'od dpag med gtso bor byas pa spyan drangs/ de la gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyi rgyas 'debs pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ste/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrubs nas/ de la rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas thogs pa rnams kyis/ tshur rang la mchod pa'i bsam pas mchod bstod bya ba rnams dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar bya ba ni lha bskyed cing mchod pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ bzlas pa la 'jug pa na/ rang gi thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar tām̐ yig dkar po langs thabs su gnas pa'i mthar/ ma ma ā yur puṇ+ya dzñā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru zhes pa'am/ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes rgyas par mdzod cig ces pa gang yang rung bas bskor ba dang*/ de'i phyi rol tām̐ gyi mdun phyogs su oṃ dang rgyab phyogs su hā bkod/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun rtsibs nas brtsams te/ yi ge re re ste brgyad dang bcas pa gsal gdab/ 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa las 'od zer ston zla'i 'od ltar 'phros/

rang gi lus thams cad du khyab pas tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas gzhan gyi srog bcad pa la sogs pa tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i sdig sgrib gang bsags bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang rje btsun ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku dang 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs nas rang la thim pas/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes thams cad rgyas par bsams la/ sngags kyi bzlas pa snying po yi ge bcu pa 'bum phrag bcu dang*/ de nyid tshe sgrub sngags dang sbrel ba'ang ci nus bzla/ tshe sgrub rgyas par bsags na 'bum phrag bzhi'i bsnyen pa bya ba yin no// gzhung dngos las ni/ ched du zla ba drug gi bar// sgrol ma'i 'khor lo bsgom byas pas// dngos grub thams cad thob 'gyur zhing*// 'chi ba'i skyon gyis mi gos so// zhes dang*/ zla ba drug tu tshang yid kyis// nges pa brtan po dag tu bya// yi ge bcu pa'i sngags 'di ni// mi skyo yid kyis bzlas par bya// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar na yi ge bcu pa zla ba drug tu bzla ba yang gsungs pa'i dus kyi bsnyen pa'o// de ltar bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas sbyin sreg byed na mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa la sogs pas mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar bya ba yin no// gsum pa ni/ bsnyen pa de sbyin bdag gi ched du dmigs bsal dgos pa'i tshe/ dang por lha bskyed bzhi'i sa bon tām̐ yig bsgom pa de yang rang dang sbyin bdag gnyis ka'i sems nyid kyi ngo bo yin snyam pa dang*/ de las 'od zer spro bsdu byas pa las byung ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo'i sku bsgom pa de'ang ngo bo rang dang sbyin bdag dbyer med kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa lha sku sgrol ma dkar mo'i rnam pa can du bsgom pa ste/ de'ang ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa snang tsam rang bzhin stong pa nyid du bsgom pa yin la/

sngags bzla ba'i tshe thugs kar zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar tām̐ yig dkar po'i khog pa sbubs stong yod pa'i nang du rang dang sbyin bdag gnyis ka'i gzugs brnyan ji lta ba re yod par gsal btab na/ tām̐ yig de rang dang sbyin bdag dbyer med du bsgom par 'gro bas yi ge bcu pa bzla ba dang*/ tshe sgrub sngags sham bu can yang oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma ā yur puṇ+ya dzñā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa ste de bod skad du bsgyur na/ bdag gi tshe bsod nams ye shes rgyas par mdzod cig ces pa'i don yin pas rang dang sbyin bdag gnyis ka'i tshe bsod nams sogs rgyas pa'i rgyur 'gro ba yin/ sngar gyi dmigs pa'i gnad de dag ma shes na/ 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags dang*/ rang gi bzla bar bya ba'i sngags kyang sbyin bdag che ge mo gang dang gang yin gyi ming de dang de'i kha bsgyur rgya skad bod skad bsgyur shes pa zhig gis min pa su yin gyis bsnyen pa byed shes pa yang ma mngon no// thugs ka'i 'khor lo'ang phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs brgyad kyi rtsa ba dang rtsibs kyi phyi rol du mu khyud dkar po rim gcig yod pa tsam gyis chog gi de las gzhan ma bshad pas mi dgos la/ 'khor lo'i lte bar tām̐ gyi mdun nas brtsams te nang skor du bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes rgyas par mdzod cig ces pas sgor mor 'khor bar yig 'bru langs thabs su yod par bsam/ yang de nyid legs sbyar gyi skad du 'god pa ltar byas kyang*/ rang gi ngag nas 'don pa bzhin byed par spro na/ ma ma ā yur puṇ+ya dzñā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru zhes pas bskor bar bsams kyang chog gnyis ka ltar yang de'i phyi rol gyi mdun phyogs su oṃ dang rgyab phyogs su hā yod pa bsgom pa yin no// rtsibs brgyad la mdun phyogs shar rtsibs la tā/ shar lhor re/ lhor tuta/ lho nub tu tā/

nub tu re/ nub byang du tu/ byang du re/ byang shar du swā rnams bkod/ de tsam las mu khyud rnams la yi ge 'god pa lugs 'di la mi bzhed pas de bzhin bya rung ba yin no// thun bsdu ba ni/ bzlas pa'i mjug mchod bstod byas la 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa rnams dkyus ltar bya'o// de ltar rang don dang gzhan don gang gtso bor byed pa'i bsnyen pa gang yin yang*/ de mthar gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ dang po rje btsun ma la sgrub thabs kyi dkyus ltar phul nas 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa sgrol ma'i bka' sdod k+ṣe tra pā la dang 'jigs byed chen po la 'bul te/ 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bka' sdod k+ṣe tra pā la zhes bya ba mi dkar dar gyi thod bcing can gos dkar gyon pa/ chos skyong 'jigs byed chen mo zhes bya ba bud med sngo bsangs dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i rnam pa can gnyis/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs nas gtor ma 'bul bar dgyes pas bzhes par bsams la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ ma hā k+ṣe tra pā lā ya i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis zhing skyong chen po la dbul/ de bzhin du/ oṃ ḍā ki ni ma hā bhai ra w+ye i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis mkha' 'gro 'jigs byed chen mo la dbul/ de nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ sngon tshe rje btsun sgrol ma'i spyan snga ru// bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro la phan gdags shing*// gang bcol phrin las sgrub par dam bcas pa// zhing skyong 'jigs byed chen mo bcas la bstod// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// zhes pa'i bar gyi phrin las bcol/

bka' sdod de gnyis ni/ bla ma gnyan lo tsā bas sgrol ma'i bsnyen pa mdzad pa'i dus su k+ṣe tra pā las 'ongs te/ nga sgrol ma'i bka' srung yin nga la gtor ma byin cig dang*/ ngas khyod sangs rgyas pa'i bar gyi yon bdag bya yis/ nga'i srog gi snying po 'bul gyis zhes smra zhing*/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la tsi ta ka yu bhe ra ta pa hūm̐ ha ho phaṭa swā hā/ zhes phul nas mi snang bar gyur to// de rjes tsam nas 'jigs byed chen mos 'ongs nas/ nga sgrol ma'i bka' sdod yin/ ngas khyod la srog gi snying po sbyin gyis/ bsnyen pa khri gyis la gtor ma byin cig ngas phrin las bzhi sgrub ces smra zhing*/ oṃ ḍā ki ni dzā la tsi ta ker te ru bhā ya swā hā zhes dbul lo// srog snying 'di gnyis sngar gyi yi ge rnying pa'i rgyun 'byams song bas sngags dag po ma byung bas gtor ma 'bul ba la'ang mtshan sngags kyis chog par byas pa yin/ de min srog sngags gnyis dag pa zhig byung na/ de la gtor sngags btags nas 'bul na'ang chog go /de nas cha gsum gtor ma btang ba'i dbang du song na/ cung zad ma gtogs kun rig ltar btang ngo*// gsum pa rjes la gnyis/ mjug gi dbye ba dngos dang phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ mdun bskyed rje btsun ma la yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyis gshegs su gsol/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung ba dang*// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs dang*/ lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis mdor bsdus kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon ni gzhung las/ tshangs dbang khyab 'jug nyi zla dang*// drag po phyogs skyong 'dod lhas kyang*// ba spu'i rtse mo bskyod mi nus// 'chi bdag las rgyal sgrol ma bzhin// skra dkar gnyer ma skal ngan dang*// nad dang dbul sogs mdor bsdu na// seng ge la sogs 'jigs chen brgyad// sdug bsngal tshogs rnams rab tu 'joms// zhes dang*/

dngos grub gzhan 'byung ba yang de nyid las// bskul ba med par gos dang ni// kha zas rin chen la sogs thog /ral gri mig sman rkang mgyogs dang*// bum pa bzang po la sogs 'grub// snyan dngags dang ni smra ba mkhas// blo rno shes rab dri ma med// gzhan yang 'dod pa'i dngos grub rnams// 'khor lo 'di las 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phan yon rnams dang*/ gzhan yang 'di nyid ni phrin las gyi lha yin/ 'phags bod kyi mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug mang pos bsgrubs pa dang gsol ba btab pa'i 'phral nyid du rjes bzung ba'i lo rgyus yid ches bskyed pa mang du mchis mod/ 'dir yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas ma bris so// yang rje tshar chen yab sras nas brgyud pa 'od zer drug sbrag bsgom pa dang thugs ka'i 'khor lo sogs khyad par rgyas tsam 'byung ba yod mod/ de'i lugs kyi rjes gnang khrid bcas thob dgos pa yod do// 'dir smras pa/ yid 'phrog mdzes sku yid kyi rtsig logs su// snang stong rtse gcig pir gyis legs bris nas// grag stong sngags kyis bzlas pas 'chi med tshe// sgrub thabs rmad byung sgrol ma zla bzhin ma// gang gi bsgom bzlas la brten rgyal ba dang*// rgyal yum sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje dang*// byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad rang dbang du// 'gugs par byed pa'i bsnyen pa bya tshul bgyis// de las skyes pa'i legs byas zla 'od gsar// mtha' yas 'gro blo'i sa dga'i me tog tshal// reg pa'i mod la tshe dpal bsod nams kyi// 'dab brgya rnam grol byang chub tshogs rgyur shog /ces sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge'i zla 'od gsar pa zhes bya ba 'di/ rdzong chen 'go'i dbu mdzad bla ma phun tshogs grags pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pas sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang po'i phyogs kyi bsti gnas su bris pa sems can thams cad la phan par gyur cig/

༈ /na mo gu rush+tsa tā ra yai/ stobs bcu'i dbang phyug ston pa shākya'i tog /rje btsun sgrol ma paṇa chen shākya shrī// mkhan chen byang chub dpal dang bde ba dpal// grags pa gzhon nu rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams grags pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs// dpal ldan tshul khrims shar chen ye shes mtshan// ngor chen kun dga' bzang po mus chen rje// paṇa chen chos dpal rnams la gsol ba 'debs// blo gros rgya mtsho rin chen bzang po dang*// sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams dkon mchog legs// dpal ldan don grub dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// sangs rgyas phun tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bkra shis lhun grub rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs// bka' srol byin rlabs dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas// bstan srung nor sbyin rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma mchog gsum gtan gyi skyabs bzung nas// bslab bya'i sdom pa nyes med bsrung ba dang*// gzhan don bla med byang chub go 'phang nyid// smon 'jug sems kyi dam bca' brling bar shog /dad gsum snying rje'i yul la nyer brten nas// rgya chen bsod nams tshogs dang chos kun gyi// gnas lugs yang dag rtogs pa'i ye shes tshogs// zung 'jug sku gnyis 'grub rgyur smin par shog /chu skyes zla ba'i gdan la tām̐ yig gi /'phro 'du las grub yid bzhin 'khor lo ma'i// mdzes sku dar babs bsgoms pas dal 'byor rten// rga shi med par rdo rje'i sku thob shog /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtsho dang 'jigs chen brgyad// nad rigs gdung ba las sgrol gsang ba'i sngags// grag stong rang bzhin med bzlas rgyal kun gyis// rjes bzung 'chi med dngos grub thob par shog /snying dbus zla ba'i 'khor lo yig 'bru las// 'od zer spro bsdus las sgrib kun sbyangs nas// 'khor 'das tshe bcud dbang bsdus bdag la thim// lus kun khyab pas 'chi med thob par shog

/mdor na 'chi bdag las rgyal sgrol ma yi// gsang gsum rnal 'byor bsgom bzlas rten 'brel gyis// bdag gi sgo gsum rdo rje gsum grub nas// bstan dang sems can don chen 'byung bar shog /ces rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ dge slong bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// grub thob thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi tshe sgrub bsnyen pa'i dmigs bsal som nyi'i mdud bu 'grol byed ces bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma rgyal ba tshe dpag med// dbyer med bsgom bzlas rnal 'byor brten// tshe srog mi shigs rdo rje'i khams// brtan byed bsnyen pa'i lag len bri// 'dir gang zag 'ga' zhig grub thob thang stong rgyal po nas brgyud pa'i tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster gyi bsnyen pa sbyin bdag sogs kyi don du dmigs pa'i tshe/ bdag mdun tha mi dad du sgrub pa'i tshul ltar na/ tshe bum tshe ril tshe chang bcas dang*/ 'bul gtor gnyis dang sngon 'gro gtor ma zhig kyang bsham mo// dngos gzhi la sngon 'gro gtor ma dang mchod pa byin rlabs sngon tu btang nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te/ ye shes tshogs bsags stong pa nyid du bsgom pa'i bar dkyus ltar dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gnas pa'i zhing 'di ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i sa gzhi lag mthil ltar snyoms pa'i sogs nas/ rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang dang sbyin bdag gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hrīḥdamar po las bdag mdun tha mi dad par tshe dpag med dkyus ltar bskyed pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i stod du hūm̐/ dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa gsal btab la/

hrīḥyig de'i gi gu'i nang du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma bsrung dgos yod na der gsal btab/ hrīḥyig gi khog pa'i sbubs stong yod pa'i dbus su rang nyid dang sbyin bdag gang yin gyi rang gzugs gsal ba'i snying gar ming yig dang po'i sa bon bcas yod par gsal gdab/ 'og gi tshe bcud bsdu ba'i dmigs pa dkyus su gsal mod/ 'dir yang cung zad brjod na/ spyi bo'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams gsal 'debs pa'i tshe rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma nas kun spangs chen po'i bar tshe dpag med kyi rnam pa can dang*/ thang stong rgyal po ni/ tshe dpag med dam grub thob rang gi cha lugs can sku mdog smug nag phyag g.yas sa non/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na tshe bum bsnams pa gang mos bskyed/ pad+ma 'byung gnas ni sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ sku la za 'og gi ber dang dar dmar po'i chos gos dang dbu la sha ba'i snyan zhu gsol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon thod pa dang tshe bum bsnams shing grub mo g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ de'i spyi bor rta mgrin ni sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs thams cad skyer sgang lugs ltar gsal gdab pa 'thad che ba mngon no// gzhan tshe dpag med dang snang ba mtha' yas ni spyi ltar ro// rtsa brgyud bla ma de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas snod kyi 'jig rten dang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams kyi bcud dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ bde ba can dang steng phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i tshe dpag med dang*/ dpal pad+ma 'od kyi zhing na bzhugs pa'i bla ma zhi khro ste pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid dang*/ zhi ba tshe dpag med dang khro bo rta mgrin gyis skur bzhengs pa'i 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog

thugs rgyud bskul bas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thams cad tshe bcud bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs pa rnams spyi bo'i bla ma rnams kyi sku dang bum pa'i nang du thim zhing sku dang bum pa las 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rgyun mi chad pa babs te/ rang tshe dpag tu med pa gsal ba'i spyi bo nas mar thim pas rang dang bsrung bya rnams kyi lus thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib tshe'i bar du gcod pa thams cad byang zhing dag tshe lo dpag tu med pa 'phel zhing rgyas nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob byung bar bsam zhing gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ tshe sgrub kyi sngags bzlas pas rang dang sbyin bdag gnyis ka'i don 'grub par 'gyur bas de ltar shes pa gal che'o// gzhan tshe ril tshe chang yod pa'i skabs su de dag la'ang tshe bcud byin rlabs bsdu ba'i dmigs pa yang yang bya ba yin no// bsnyen pa'i thun mtshams thams cad du mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas rang tshe dpag med kyi rnam pa byas ste gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ spyod lam gyi bya ba rnams bya'o// mjug bsnyen pa grol ba'i nyin gtor ma 'bul tshar rjes su dbang dang dngos grub len par 'dod na mdun bskyed kyi tshe bum de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tshe dpag med dbyer med du dmigs nas dbang chog rnams de nyid kyis mdzad par bsams la rang gi ngag tu brjod cing dbang rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa blang ngo*// de nas mchod pa kha gsos te byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchod bstod 'dod gsol sogs nas/ bkra shis kyi mtha' brgyan pa'i bar dkyus ltar bya'o// rnal 'byor rang gzhan gnyis don du// bsnyen sgrub dmigs bsal dgos pa'i phyogs// som nyi'i mdud bu 'grol byed 'di// byas pas 'gro la phan gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang sbyin bdag gi ched du tshe sgrub bsnyen mtshams byed pa rnams kyi dmigs bsal khyad chos sbyor rgyur som nyi'i mdud bu 'grol byed ces bya ba 'di ni/
ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
